svg.text: What every single LLM call pays before it sees a byte of your request.
AUDIT TRAIL — WHAT THE FIRST DRAWING GOT WRONG
1. AIDER was drawn at 264 tok. It is 1,265: format_chat_chunks appends system_reminder and sends the few-shot examples as real turns.
And its repo map is not 1,024 — with no files added to the chat the target becomes 1,024 x 8 = 8,192 tokens (repomap.py:56,124-132).
2. OPENCODE was drawn at 643 tok. That file is a per-model PLUGIN. The base prompt is 189 tok; assembled with tool guidance it is 333.
3. VOID was drawn at 380 tok. Its message ends with a rendered file TREE, capped at 20,000 chars — assembled it is 1,400.
4. OUR tool schemas alone (7,509 tok) are 2.7x the ENTIRE fixed cost of OpenCode (2,816) and 4.0x Void's (1,897). That is the finding; the prose was beside the point.
